exposure: fetal biometric parameters (estimated fetal weight (EFW), head circumference (HC), biparietal diameter (BPD), abdominal circumference (AC), femur length (FL))
outcome: cesarean delivery due to labor dystocia (LD)
cohort: The study included 243 pregnant women with singleton, cephalic presentation, term pregnancies, and no contraindications for vaginal delivery.
finding: The FBP/MH ratio was identified as an independent risk factor for predicting cesarean delivery due to labor dystocia, and a predictive model incorporating this ratio showed excellent performance (AUC of 0.905).
mod_finding: The FBP/MH ratio is an independent risk factor for predicting cesarean delivery due to labor dystocia.
